# Single-cell clonotype clustering {#sec-sc-clustering}

::: {.callout-note collapse="true"}
## About this section
This section is added because the run used **single-cell** TCR data. GIANA and GLIPH2 (per
patient) and TCRdist3 (per sample) group clonotypes by receptor similarity, on the reasoning
that similar receptors are likely to recognise the same antigen. Their assignments were mapped
back onto cells (`CLUSTER_TO_SC`) and reconciled into one **consensus cluster** per cell: the
label at least `consensus_min_methods` methods agree on. This section reports how much of each
patient's repertoire was clustered, which cell states the consensus clusters occupy, how they
persist across samples, and, when available, how they relate to CoNGA and TCRi.
:::

## Clustering coverage {#sec-sc-cluster-coverage}

```{python}
#| output: asis
#| echo: false

_methods = [('giana_cluster', 'GIANA'), ('gliph_cluster', 'GLIPH2'),
            ('tcrdist_cluster', 'TCRdist3'), ('consensus_cluster', 'Consensus')]
if sc_tcr is None or not sc_has_consensus:
    sc_note("Consensus clustering did not run for this run, so no per-cell cluster assignments "
            "are available.")
else:
    rows = []
    for col, name in _methods:
        if col in sc_tcr.columns:
            has = sc_tcr[col].astype('string').fillna('').str.strip().ne('')
            for p, v in has.groupby(sc_tcr[subject_col]):
                rows.append(dict(patient=p, method=name, frac=v.mean(), cells=int(v.sum()), total=len(v)))
    d = pd.DataFrame(rows)
    fig = px.bar(d, x='patient', y='frac', color='method', barmode='group',
                 category_orders={'method': [m for _, m in _methods], 'patient': sc_patients},
                 color_discrete_sequence=['#66c2a5', '#fc8d62', '#8da0cb', '#e78ac3'],
                 hover_data={'cells': True, 'total': True, 'frac': ':.1%'},
                 labels={'patient': 'Patient', 'frac': 'Fraction of TCR+ cells clustered', 'method': ''},
                 title='Share of TCR+ cells assigned to a cluster, per method')
    fig.update_yaxes(tickformat='.0%')
    sc_show(fig)
```
**Figure SC-P1. Clustering coverage.** The share of each patient's TCR+ cells whose clonotype was placed in a cluster by each method, and by the consensus. The methods use different notions of similarity, so their coverage differs. The consensus is the most conservative because it needs agreement. Low coverage is expected for small or very diverse repertoires.

## Consensus clusters {#sec-sc-consensus}

```{python}
#| output: asis
#| echo: false

if sc_tcr is None or not sc_has_consensus:
    sc_note("Consensus clustering did not run for this run.")
else:
    cc = sc_tcr[sc_tcr['consensus_cluster'].astype('string').fillna('').str.strip().ne('')]
    if cc.empty:
        sc_note("No cell received a consensus cluster: no clonotype was clustered by enough "
                "methods. Lowering `--consensus_min_methods` makes the consensus less strict.")
    else:
        size = cc.groupby('consensus_cluster')['cell_id'].size()
        top = size.sort_values(ascending=False).index[:25].tolist()
        t = cc[cc['consensus_cluster'].isin(top)]
        pat_of = t.groupby('consensus_cluster')[subject_col].agg(lambda s: ', '.join(sorted(set(s))))
        ylab = {c: f'{c} ({pat_of[c]}, {size[c]} cells)' for c in top}

        # (a) Which samples / timepoints each cluster appears in.
        g = t.groupby(['consensus_cluster', 'sample']).size().rename('cells').reset_index()
        g['frac'] = g['cells'] / g['sample'].map(sc_tcr.groupby('sample').size())
        g['label'] = g['sample'].map(sc_alias).fillna(g['sample'])
        g['y'] = g['consensus_cluster'].map(ylab)
        cols = [sc_alias.get(s, s) for s in sc_sample_order if s in set(g['sample'])]
        fig = px.scatter(g, x='label', y='y', size='cells', color='frac', size_max=22,
                         category_orders={'label': cols, 'y': [ylab[c] for c in top]},
                         color_continuous_scale='Viridis',
                         hover_data={'cells': True, 'frac': ':.2%', 'y': False},
                         labels={'label': 'Sample (grouped by patient, ordered by timepoint)', 'y': '',
                                 'frac': 'Share of<br>sample TCR+'},
                         title='Top consensus clusters across samples')
        sc_show(fig, height=max(SC_HEIGHT, 24 * len(top) + 180))

        # (b) Cell states of each cluster.
        if sc_has_annot:
            m = pd.crosstab(t['consensus_cluster'], t['annot'])
            frac = m.div(m.sum(axis=1), axis=0).reindex(top)
            keep = frac.max().sort_values(ascending=False).index[:15]
            frac = frac[keep]
            fig = go.Figure(go.Heatmap(z=frac.values, x=list(keep), y=[ylab[c] for c in top],
                                       colorscale='Blues', zmin=0, zmax=1,
                                       customdata=m.reindex(top)[keep].values,
                                       colorbar=dict(title='Fraction', tickformat='.0%'),
                                       hovertemplate='%{y}<br>%{x}: %{z:.0%} (%{customdata} cells)<extra></extra>'))
            fig.update_layout(title='Cell-state composition of the top consensus clusters')
            fig.update_yaxes(autorange='reversed')
            sc_show(fig, height=max(SC_HEIGHT, 24 * len(top) + 180))
```
**Figure SC-P2. Consensus clusters.** The 25 largest consensus clusters, labelled with the patient(s) they come from and their cell count. The dot plot shows the samples each cluster appears in: dot size is the number of cells and colour is the share of that sample's TCR+ cells. The heatmap shows each cluster's cell-state make-up. A cluster recovered at several timepoints, or in both blood and tissue, is a group of similar receptors persisting across the response. A cluster concentrated in one effector or exhausted state is a candidate antigen-specific family.

## Consensus clusters, CoNGA and TCRi {#sec-sc-consensus-scores}

```{python}
#| output: asis
#| echo: false

if sc_tcr is None or not sc_has_consensus or not (sc_has_conga or sc_has_tcri):
    sc_note("Needs consensus clusters plus CoNGA or TCRi scores (a GEX object).")
else:
    cc = sc_tcr[sc_tcr['consensus_cluster'].astype('string').fillna('').str.strip().ne('')]
    agg = dict(cells=('cell_id', 'size'), patients=(subject_col, lambda s: ', '.join(sorted(set(s)))),
               state=('annot', lambda s: s.value_counts().index[0]),
               samples=('sample', 'nunique'))
    if sc_has_conga:
        agg['conga_hits'] = ('conga_hit', 'mean')
    if sc_has_tcri:
        agg['mean_tcri'] = ('tcri_score', 'mean')
    d = cc.groupby('consensus_cluster').agg(**agg).reset_index()
    d = d[d['cells'] >= SC_MIN_CELLS]
    if d.empty:
        sc_note(f"No consensus cluster reaches {SC_MIN_CELLS} cells.")
    else:
        if sc_has_conga and sc_has_tcri:
            fig = px.scatter(d, x='conga_hits', y='mean_tcri', size='cells', color='state',
                             hover_name='consensus_cluster',
                             hover_data={'patients': True, 'samples': True, 'cells': True},
                             color_discrete_map=sc_annot_colors(sc_tcr['annot'].unique()),
                             labels={'conga_hits': 'Cells in CoNGA hits', 'mean_tcri': 'Mean TCRi score',
                                     'state': 'Dominant state'},
                             title='Consensus clusters: CoNGA support vs TCRi score')
            fig.update_xaxes(tickformat='.0%')
        else:
            ycol = 'conga_hits' if sc_has_conga else 'mean_tcri'
            d = d.sort_values(ycol, ascending=False).head(30)
            fig = px.bar(d, x='consensus_cluster', y=ycol, color='state',
                         category_orders={'consensus_cluster': d['consensus_cluster'].tolist()},
                         hover_data={'patients': True, 'samples': True, 'cells': True},
                         color_discrete_map=sc_annot_colors(sc_tcr['annot'].unique()),
                         labels={'consensus_cluster': 'Consensus cluster', 'conga_hits': 'Cells in CoNGA hits',
                                 'mean_tcri': 'Mean TCRi score', 'state': 'Dominant state'},
                         title='Consensus clusters ranked by ' + ('CoNGA support' if sc_has_conga else 'TCRi score'))
            if ycol == 'conga_hits':
                fig.update_yaxes(tickformat='.0%')
        fig.update_traces(marker=dict(line=dict(width=0.5, color='white')))
        sc_show(fig, height=480)
```
**Figure SC-P3. Sequence clusters set against transcriptome-aware evidence.** Each point is a consensus cluster with at least 10 cells, sized by cell count and coloured by its dominant state. The x-axis is the share of its cells in CoNGA hit clonotypes, meaning receptor similarity mirrored by transcriptional similarity. The y-axis is the cluster's mean TCRi score, meaning how strongly the receptors encode a phenotype bias. Clusters high on both axes are supported by sequence, transcriptome and receptor-intrinsic evidence, and are the strongest candidates for shared antigen specificity.
